assets.caption: The scene is an intimate music room or performance space, rendered in a realistic, almost cinematic style, exuding an atmosphere of old-world charm and quiet anticipation. The room features dark wood paneling that covers all walls, creating a sense of warmth and acoustic richness. A grand piano, its dark, polished surface reflecting the subdued light, stands against the far wall, positioned next to a complete drum kit with brass cymbals and a light brown finish. An amplifier or speaker cabinet sits adjacent to the piano, ready to project sound. Rows of chairs with dark, padded seats and black frames are meticulously arranged in front of the performance area, each accompanied by a music stand holding sheet music, indicating a performance or practice session is imminent. The wooden floor, with visible signs of wear and age, adds to the room's character. A wooden door with a narrow, vertical window is visible on the left side of the room, suggesting an exit or entrance. A small, wheeled cart with shelves holding white towels or cloths is positioned near the door. A single wall sconce with a warm, amber glow illuminates a section of the paneled wall above the amplifier, providing subtle accent lighting. The grand piano occupies the central back area, with the drum kit placed directly in front of it and slightly to the right. The amplifier stands to the right of the piano. The chairs with music stands are arranged in neat rows facing the piano and drum kit, extending from the right side of the frame towards the left. The wheeled cart is situated against the left wall, near the wooden door. The 360 scene is faultless.
